# Capnp.jl

Capnp.jl is a Julia package that implements Cap'n Proto data serialization and RPC.
It provides zero-copy serialization and deserialization of Cap'n Proto messages, leveraging native Julia structures.

## Key Features
- Zero-copy deserialization: Data is read directly from memory buffers without allocation overhead.
- Native compiler plugin (`capnpc-jl`): Generates Julia code from `.capnp` schema files.
- Cap'n Proto RPC (Experimental): Partial support for the Cap'n Proto RPC protocol.

## Documentation
- [Home](https://s-celles.github.io/Capnp.jl/dev/)
- [Source Code](https://github.com/s-celles/Capnp.jl)

## Usage Example
```julia
using Capnp
include("schema.capnp.jl")

message = Capnp.AllocMessageBuilder()
# populate message...
Capnp.writeMessageToStream(message, stdout)
```
